final: SELECT step1.Name, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg AS difference FROM (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name) step1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_ratios.avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name) avg_ratios) step2 WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg
